title: The boss lab's bait mode landed: Isao flies low as the creature's bait and the player is the gunner (labs.html#boss, mode: bait; --boss-bait green)
context: The plan of 2026-10-09-boss-bait-mode-design, built on the unpushed branch refactor-run in six commits (git log --oneline c9a45ae2..HEAD at the time of this record): a9d0d89f the bait's rules are pure (src/domain/boss-bait.js, playerShot in boss-fight.js, test/boss-bait.mjs); a117b24c the acceptance handle moves to src/labs/boss/handle.js (no behaviour change); 645c8a57 the bait mode in the lab (src/labs/boss/bait.js: Isao's model and routing, the health row, LOST cards, the line triggers); c01c468c the gunner seat (src/labs/boss/seat.js: the optic, the reticle, the trigger); 1202538b the review's first fixes (the game camera's rear inset and lens go with the tank, the readout and panel speak of the player's MK-9 and guns, a shared-frame kill takes Isao down); 9d8ea618 the seat finished (Isao's cyan ring and ISAO tag, the minors). The commit that carries this record adds the --boss-bait browser step.
outcome: The mode: `mode` select (tank by default, every earlier step unchanged); in bait mode the tank, the cannon, the game camera, SOL and the lure are out of the panel and the readout, the rotary, Bofors and MK-9 switches gate the player's guns (a gun switched off cannot be selected or fired, the fight switch silences the seat and its strip says so), the readout shows the player's MK-9 reload (MK-9 ready / in s). Isao keeps his distance from the creature's HELD front edge (each floor contact stays 2.5 s after the foot lifts: with raw contacts the edge jumped an arm's length with every footfall and he lunged in and fled). The seat: the optic is the main camera over the whole stage (340 m up, 60/zoom degrees, each gun's own zoom x2), WASD or the stage's edge pans, the wheel zooms, 1 2 3 pick the 25 mm, 40 mm and MK-9, hold to fire; the reticle is a cross with a dashed ring of the gun's damage radius. Isao wears a cyan ring (#7fe6d0) with an `ISAO <hp>` tag in screen space, dashed at the edge of the clear view with an arrow when he flies out of it. THE PYRRHIC-WIN RULE (made here as the default; the owner's call at his playtest): when one blow takes both in a frame (the MK-9 finishing the creature and Isao), the round is KILLED, the creature is dead, and the card reads `KILLED · ... · Isao down`; Isao vanishes in his burst in every phase. The KILLED card carries Isao's hit points (`Isao 12/12`). Isao's lines: `bait_hurt` (first and second hit), `bait_taunt` (a contact within 25 m), `bait_death` (below 30 %), `bait_not_today` (2 s after, if he lives), one line every 4 s, a caption until his recorded takes are exported; a recorded take is asked for by the caption's exact text. OWNER'S PLAYTEST POINTS: (1) the pyrrhic-win rule above, whether KILLED with Isao down is a win. (2) Isao's height: 4 m in the lab (the panel's bait altitude knob, 2-20 m) against the game's 17.75 m (3.4 wall-heights, content bait.altitude); at 4 m he is a 1.8 m drone beside a 30 m creature, at 17.75 m the rounds' ground points are far below him. (3) The optic as the main view: the 25 mm sees about 70 m across, the 40 mm about 100 m, the look point is fixed (WASD pans, nothing follows him) and Isao circles out of it every few seconds, so the ring at the edge is the only guide; the lab's panel covers the right 245 px of the stage. A follow or a wider default is the owner's call. (4) Leading a moving Isao: the 40 mm's 2.6 s flight at his 14 m/s is about 36 m of lead (the MK-9's 4.2 s about 59 m, forgiven by its 55 m ring); the 25 mm on the creature's far foot kills it in about 30 s. (5) His five lines wait for the owner's approval in seiyu_voice (commit 859f158, section 14 of ISAO-VOICE-LINES.md): cd ~/Dev/seiyu_voice && .venv/bin/isao serve --port 8766, approve, then isao export and node scripts/import-isao-voice.mjs in Stalheart; until then the lab shows captions.
alternatives: The optic as a 44 % inset in the lab's frame (the gunship lab's lens): rejected; a 30 m creature and a 1.8 m drone need the whole stage's pixels (Isao was a few pixels in the inset).
The planner following the creature's raw floor contacts: rejected; the front edge flickers (7.7 to 46.2 m of gap against 7.5 to 22.7 with the 2.5 s hold).

A shared-frame kill as LOST (Isao down wins over the creature's death): not chosen; it hid his death in the old order and made the MK-9 finisher a loss. KILLED with Isao down is the default; the owner may decide it a draw or a loss.
evidence: scripts/browser-test.mjs --boss-bait from an APFS snapshot of the final tree, headless on kainode (2026-10-09), PASS, final run: Isao's gap to the held front edge over 10 s of lab clock, 97 samples, min 10.6 m, median 19.3 m, p90 20.0 m, max 29.9 m, 71 % within 17-23 m (eight runs: median 19.2-19.7 m, p90 20.0-20.7 m, min 3.7-10.6 m: the arm lunges dip lower and recover in about 0.7 s)

--boss-bait probes, final run: the 40 mm on the creature's far side for 3 s lab clock: 7 rounds, hits 0 -> 6, creature hp 180 -> 158.9, Isao 12 -> 12; the 40 mm led onto Isao by his measured velocity over the round's 2.6 s flight: 12 -> 11.2 in 3.8 s (earlier runs 8.1 to 11.8); the MK-9 led onto him: LOST `Isao down` 4.6 s of lab clock after the shot, card `LOST · Isao down`, his marker hidden; R restarts whole (hp 180/180, Isao 12/12, the reticle on the look point); the pyrrhic round (the 25 mm to 13.9 hp, the creature held still, the MK-9 on its middle): `KILLED 0:32.1 · 2 hits · Isao down`, Isao 0 and gone; the scripted kill (the 25 mm held on the creature's far foot): KILLED at 0:30.0 of fight clock, 30.1 s real, 1 hit, held 5 s with `Isao 12/12` on the card and no red ring left under a held trigger; no shader error, no frame error

--boss-bait also asserts the rear inset off (cam().on false, the frame hidden, no rearMs, the lens not 68), the readout without lure / nuke in / camera game and with MK-9 ready|in, the lure select hidden, the panel's 40 mm switch refusing the gun, the SOL switch hidden, the seat's strip naming the fight switch, and the marker's tag

--boss green (held 97/97 over 606 frames, parked tank taken after 10.1 s, radius 15.6 m) and --boss-cam green (rear inset 0.25 ms a frame) on the final snapshot; npm test 219 programs, npm run check, npm run build green

--boss-fight, the final snapshot: PASS 3 of 3 (hp 90.8-92.9 of 180 at 22.2 s, 15 hits). An earlier snapshot of the same src: PASS, FAIL, FAIL (the circling tank LOST to a Bofors round at 15.03 s of fight clock, the step's 'all four shooters' plans showed'). c9a45ae2 from its own snapshot: PASS 3 of 3; 645c8a57: 3 of 3; c01c468c (the seat's commit): 2 of 3, the failure the same state at 15.03 s. The review saw 8/11 against 11/12 at baseline. The failing round is the seed-1 schedule's Bofors landing meeting the circling tank, which the lab's frame timing decides; no code path from the bait or the seat reaches the tank mode's sim (seat.tick returns before touching anything), so it is read as the step's known flake, not as a regression, but the rate after the seat is higher than before it and is left unexplained
